split.seed_color_source: Training RGB only; points retriangulated from training observations at fixed RGB-derived poses
split.pose_scope: Offline COLMAP camera estimates use the full image set. This is a fixed-camera held-out RGB comparison, not an online causal reconstruction benchmark.

comparison: Same RGB-derived cameras, training-only re-triangulated/colorized seed, seed=42, held-out RGB timestamps, no Harmonizer or image enhancement
metric_scope: Per-image PSNR/SSIM averaged over all 24 matched native views. Background scores exclude detector road-user boxes; these are estimates, not ground-truth masks. Camera estimation uses all RGB views offline.
ssim_definition: RGB channels averaged; Gaussian sigma=1.5, truncate=3.5, C1=.01^2, C2=.03^2; full-image mean excludes a 5-pixel border
